lines.en: label kaoridate15:
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点下手机里 Kaori 的名字，等她接起来。

lines.en: She’s typically working around this time but somehow always manages to pick up, so I’m not all that worried.
lines.zh: 这个时间她一般在上班，可她不知怎么的总能接起来，所以我也没那么担心。

lines.en: Granted, she also somehow always manages to be in every single place at once, so I’m pretty sure that there are either duplicates of her roaming around or that she’s just 90%% magic.
lines.zh: 话说回来，她也不知怎么地总能同时出现在每一个地方，所以我相当肯定，要么是有好几个她的复制体在四处晃悠，要么她本身就是 90%% 的魔法。

lines.en: : Phone call!
lines.zh: : 电话！

lines.en: : Well that’s a new greeting.
lines.zh: : 哟，这问候倒是新鲜。

lines.en: : Good morning, Friend! To what do I owe the talking today?
lines.zh: : 早上好，朋友！今天是什么风把你吹来跟我说话的？

lines.en: : Just seeing what my favorite waitress is up to. Are you at work right now?
lines.zh: : 就是看看我最喜欢的服务员在忙什么。你现在在上班吗？

lines.en: : I am always at work!
lines.zh: : 我永远都在上班！

lines.en: : Cool. Do you have time to go on break for a little bit if I swing by?
lines.zh: : 好。要是我顺路过去，你有时间休息一会儿吗？

lines.en: : The whole day is a break! I do not have work!
lines.zh: : 一整天都是休息！我今天没有班！

lines.en: : But...you just said-
lines.zh: : 可是……你刚才说——

lines.en: : Friend, I have been having many lightbulbs inside of my brain and all of them are going BZZZZ BZZZZ and I believe it means there is something we must do!
lines.zh: : 朋友，我脑子里一直在冒出好多灯泡，它们全都在 BZZZZ BZZZZ 地响，我觉得这意味着我们有一件必须去做的事！

lines.en: : Please continue to explain.
lines.zh: : 请继续说下去。

lines.en: : I would like to spend the day with you and show you the light bulbs!
lines.zh: : 我想和你待上一整天，把那些灯泡给你看！

lines.en: : If this winds up being something like you literally needing help changing a light bulb I am going to lose interest very quickly.
lines.zh: : 如果最后发现就是你需要人帮忙换个灯泡，那我的兴趣会掉得非常快。

lines.en: : Darn!
lines.zh: : 可恶！

lines.en: : Was that really what it was?
lines.zh: : 真的就是这个吗？

lines.en: : I don’t like sleeping in the dark, so sometimes my light bulbs get tired and need to take a break for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢在黑暗里睡觉，所以有时候我的灯泡会累，需要永远地休息下去。

lines.en: : Isn’t one of your nicknames literally the Mistress of the Dark?
lines.zh: : 你的外号里不是有一个就叫「黑暗女王」吗？

lines.en: : Mistress of the Burger! Let’s hang the outs for an entire day! Just you and me!
lines.zh: : 是汉堡女王！我们出去玩一整天吧！就你和我！

lines.en: : And John!
lines.zh: : 还有 John！

lines.en: : And John’s friends!
lines.zh: : 还有 John 的朋友们！

lines.en: : John has friends now?
lines.zh: : John 现在有朋友了？

lines.en: : Not yet! But I will explain when we get there!
lines.zh: : 还没有！不过等我们到了那儿我再解释！

lines.en: : Get {i}where{/i}, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 到{i}哪儿{/i}，Kaori？

lines.en: : There!
lines.zh: : 那儿！

lines.en: : I will see you soon!
lines.zh: : 我们很快见！

lines.en: : Phone call!
lines.zh: : 电话！

lines.en: : Phone call.
lines.zh: : 电话。

lines.en: scene black
I decide to stop ever complaining about how Kaori starts or ends calls because, at this point, what would complaining even do?
lines.zh: 我决定再也不抱怨 Kaori 是怎么开场、怎么结束电话的了，因为到了这一步，抱怨又能有什么用呢？

lines.en: Despite not telling me where she wants to meet...I have a pretty good feeling that it’s in that alleyway with all of the chickens we’ve visited before.
lines.zh: 虽然她没说想在哪儿碰头……但我有种很强烈的预感，就是我们以前去过的那条全是鸡的小巷。

lines.en: Especially since today is apparently going to involve procuring friends for her obnoxiously large pet.
lines.zh: 尤其是，今天显然还要给她那只大得离谱的宠物弄几个朋友回来。

lines.en: So, either Kaori’s landlord is about to hate her for turning her place into a chicken coop...or she somehow lives on a secret farm somewhere in the middle of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 所以，要么是 Kaori 的房东快要因为她把住处变成鸡舍而恨死她……要么就是她不知怎么地住在 Kumon-mi 正中央某个秘密农场里。

lines.en: Both of these things seem entirely plausible for someone like her.
lines.zh: 对像她这样的人来说，这两种情况都完全说得通。

lines.en: But I should probably start getting a move on if I don’t want her to wind up overpaying for a chicken or-
lines.zh: 不过我要是不想让她最后花冤枉钱买下一只鸡或者——那我大概该动身了。

lines.en: God, what has happened to my life?
lines.zh: 老天，我的人生到底变成什么样了？

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate1
Just as I expected, Kaori wanted to meet in the chicken alley- a real place that exists in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 正如我所料，Kaori 想在鸡巷碰头——一个真实存在于 Kumon-mi 的地方。

lines.en: Well, apparently it’s not exactly a chicken alley anymore since, according to Kaori, the previous owner of the chickens recently sold them to another restaurant manager a few blocks down.
lines.zh: 嗯，显然它现在已经不完全是鸡巷了，因为据 Kaori 说，那些鸡的前主人最近把它们卖给了几个街区外另一家餐厅的老板。

lines.en: So the two of us make our way down this wind tunnel of a shortcut in hope of being able to purchase-
lines.zh: 于是我俩沿着这条像风洞一样的近路往前走，希望能买——

lines.en: : Wait, how many more chickens did you plan on buying?
lines.zh: : 等等，你打算再买多少只鸡？

lines.en: : As many as I can fit in my arm feet!
lines.zh: : 能塞进我胳膊脚里多少，就买多少！

lines.en: : Hands. And I can’t imagine that is very many.
lines.zh: : 那叫手。而且我想也塞不了多少。

lines.en: : Then Friend can help carry chickens as well since his arm feet are bigger and stronger!
lines.zh: : 那朋友也可以帮忙拿鸡，因为他的胳膊脚更大更有劲！

lines.en: : Hands. Please stop calling them arm feet.
lines.zh: : 是手。拜托别再叫它们胳膊脚了。

lines.en: : Friend, do you know that John misses you?
lines.zh: : 朋友，你知道 John 想你了吗？

lines.en: : How would I possibly know something like that, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能知道这种事，Kaori？

lines.en: : Chicken-sense! Friend-sense!
lines.zh: : 鸡的直觉！朋友的直觉！

lines.en: : Like how I feel every time I know you are nearby!
lines.zh: : 就像每次我知道你在附近时，感觉到的那样！

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time believing you can somehow sense my presence based on nothing but our friendship.
lines.zh: : 我很难相信你能仅凭我们之间的友情，就感应到我在场。

lines.en: : Maybe my friendship muscles are just stronger than yours?
lines.zh: : 也许我的友情肌肉就是比你的强壮呢？

lines.en: : Those aren’t even a-
lines.zh: : 那根本就不——

lines.en: : Don’t doubt my feelings for you, Chickenburger Friend Man!
lines.zh: : 别怀疑我对你的感情，鸡肉堡朋友人！

lines.en: : These names are getting out of arm feet.
lines.zh: : 这些外号已经越来越超出胳膊脚了。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate2
: Arm feet!
lines.zh: : 胳膊脚！

lines.en: : Oh God damnit.
lines.zh: : 哦，该死。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate3
: Th...Thank you for coming today!
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢你今天过来！

lines.en: : I was worried you would have turned your leg machines into escape mode when I told you I wanted to be with you for the entire day.
lines.zh: : 我本来还担心，一听说我想和你待一整天，你就会把腿机器调成逃跑模式。

lines.en: : No need to thank me. I’m the one who called you, remember?
lines.zh: : 不用谢。是我打给你的，记得吗？

lines.en: : Of course! It’s much easier to remember things from this morning than things from a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 当然！今天早上发生的事，可比很久以前的事好记多了。

lines.en: : That is how memory works in most cases, yes.
lines.zh: : 大多数情况下，记忆确实是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Are you good at remembering things, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你擅长记事情吗，朋友？

lines.en: : Not exactly.
lines.zh: : 不怎么擅长。

lines.en: : Me too!
lines.zh: : 我也是！

lines.en: : Did you also get hurt when you were a mini human?
lines.zh: : 你当小人儿的时候，也受过伤吗？

lines.en: scene happy9
scene kaoribigdate3
: Also?
: Yes!
lines.zh: : 是的！

lines.en: : I have told you about the juice before, yes?
lines.zh: : 我以前跟你说过「汁液」的事吧？

lines.en: Ahh. I guess she’s talking about her apparent familiarity with hospitals again.
lines.zh: 啊。看来她又在说自己对医院那股莫名的熟络劲儿了。

lines.en: Am I actually about to learn why Kaori acts and speaks the way she does?
lines.zh: 我真的要弄明白 Kaori 为什么会这样说话、这样行事了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. You have told me about the juice.
lines.zh: : 是的。你跟我说过汁液的事。

lines.en: : What happened to you that...led you to the juice, though?
lines.zh: : 可是……你身上发生了什么，才让你用上那些汁液的？

lines.en: That is absolutely not how I imagined ever asking anyone about their past.
lines.zh: 这绝对不是我想象中向别人打听过去的方式。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate4
: WHAPAM! BOOM! KCHHHHHH!!
lines.zh: : WHAPAM！BOOM！KCHHHHHH！！

lines.en: And that is absolutely not how I imagined anyone ever explaining it.
lines.zh: 而这绝对不是我想象中任何人解释它的方式。

lines.en: : And on that day...a baby spider hatched!
lines.zh: : 就在那一天……一只小蜘蛛孵化了！

lines.en: : The Mistress of the Burger Dark escaped the clutches of evil robots and started her new life as a superhero who saves furry or fluffy or feathery creatures!
lines.zh: : 汉堡黑暗女王逃出了邪恶机器人的魔爪，开始了她作为超级英雄的新生活，专门拯救毛茸茸的、软乎乎的、或者长羽毛的生物！

lines.en: Or she’s just delusional.
lines.zh: 或者她只是产生了幻觉。

lines.en: : WHAPSSSSHHHHHHH!!!
lines.zh: : WHAPSSSSHHHHHHH！！！

lines.en: She is definitely delusional.
lines.zh: 她绝对是产生了幻觉。

lines.en: : What are the sound effects for, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 那些音效是干什么用的，Kaori？

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate5
: Sound effects?
lines.zh: : 音效？

lines.en: : Those...sounds you were making.
lines.zh: : 就是……你刚才发出的那些声音。

lines.en: : Do you not know Latin, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你不懂拉丁语吗，朋友？

lines.en: : No...And neither do you.
lines.zh: : 不懂……你也不懂。

lines.en: : “WHAPSSSSHHHHHHH!!!” is Latinspeak for “Life is good now!”
lines.zh: : 「WHAPSSSSHHHHHHH！！！」用拉丁语来说，就是「现在的日子很好！」

lines.en: : Are you sure it was okay for you to leave the hospital?
lines.zh: : 你确定你离开医院真的没问题吗？

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate6
: Yes! My yoke is easy and my burden is light!
lines.zh: : 当然！我的轭是轻省的，我的担子也不重！

lines.en: : There is no reason to stay in one place when the juice is but juice and the animals are elsewhere!
lines.zh: : 汁液不过就是汁液，而动物们还在别处，那又有什么理由一直待在一个地方！

lines.en: : And so I ask you, Friend of Friends, to help me acquire more of you!
lines.zh: : 所以我要请求你，朋友中的朋友，帮我再弄到更多像你这样的存在！

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate7
: To multiply the friendship in the world by a kadrillionbilliontrillion and-
lines.zh: : 把世界上的友情乘以一卡兆亿京倍，然后——

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate8
: Huh?
: What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : There’s nothing in the cages.
lines.zh: : 笼子里什么都没有。

lines.en: : This is where I was told that John’s friends would be.
lines.zh: : 人家告诉我，John 的朋友们就在这儿。

lines.en: : Do non-Kaori humans normally take chickens inside to roam around during the morning?
lines.zh: : 不是 Kaori 的人类，早上一般会把鸡放进去到处溜达吗？

lines.en: : No. That’s not normally a thing non-Kaori humans do.
lines.zh: : 不。不是 Kaori 的人类一般不会干这种事。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate9
: Should we find four-legged foldable rectangles to sit on them in wait of our new friends’ arrival?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要找些四条腿的可折叠长方形，坐上去等我们的新朋友到来？

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure this is the right place?
lines.zh: : 你绝对确定是这个地方吗？

lines.en: : Yes! I checked the address the last chicken seller gave me many times!
lines.zh: : 当然！上个卖鸡的人给我的地址，我核对过好多遍了！

lines.en: : It is why I am not carrying food items today!
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我今天没带吃的东西！

lines.en: : Kaori...
lines.zh: : Kaori……

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate10
: Why do you say my name with so much sadness?
lines.zh: : 你为什么用这么伤心的语气叫我的名字？

lines.en: : I think that maybe we’re just...
lines.zh: : 我想，也许我们只是……

lines.en: : A little too late.
lines.zh: : 来晚了一点。

lines.en: : Too late?...
lines.zh: : 来晚了？……

lines.en: : Did someone else purchase the friends before I could?
lines.zh: : 是有人抢在我之前把朋友们买走了吗？

lines.en: : Either that or-
lines.zh: : 要么是那样，要么——

lines.en: scene happy9
scene kaoribigdate11
: Or what?
lines.zh: : 要么什么？

lines.en: : If you know what happened, please tell me.
lines.zh: : 如果你知道发生了什么，请告诉我。

lines.en: : Our day can not continue until I acquire at least one new companion.
lines.zh: : 在我至少得到一个新伙伴之前，我们这一天没法继续下去。

lines.en: : When you asked the previous owner of the chickens where they’d be, what did he tell you?
lines.zh: : 你问那些鸡的前主人它们会在哪儿的时候，他是怎么跟你说的？

lines.en: : That I could see them if I went to this building.
lines.zh: : 他说我到这栋楼来，就能看到它们。

lines.en: : But I don’t see anything at all.
lines.zh: : 可我什么都没看到。

lines.en: : He didn’t tell you you could buy them, though?
lines.zh: : 可他没说你可以把它们买下来吧？

lines.en: : He said it wasn’t up to him since they were no longer in his possession.
lines.zh: : 他说这事儿他说了不算，因为它们已经不在他手里了。

lines.en: : And they were sold to another restaurant?
lines.zh: : 它们被卖给了另一家餐厅？

lines.en: : Yes. Another one that will not hire me. The one we are behind right now.
lines.zh: : 是的。又一家不肯雇我的店。就是我们此刻背后这一家。

lines.en: : Then...they were probably used already.
lines.zh: : 那……它们大概已经被用掉了。

lines.en: : Used?
lines.zh: : 用掉？

lines.en: : Killed.
lines.zh: : 杀掉了。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate12
: I see.
scene kaoribigdate13
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Friend. Can I ask you a question?
lines.zh: : 朋友。我能问你一个问题吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Go ahead.
lines.zh: : 当然。问吧。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate14
: What happens when something dies?
lines.zh: : 有东西死掉的时候，会发生什么？

lines.en: : That’s not an easy question to answer.
lines.zh: : 这不是个容易回答的问题。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不容易？

lines.en: : Because it’s not really something anyone knows.
lines.zh: : 因为这其实是谁都不知道的事。

lines.en: : For us, the ones who haven’t died, life continues to move on...albeit a little bit slower than before.
lines.zh: : 对我们这些还没死的人来说，生活还是会继续往前走……只是比从前慢上一点点。

lines.en: : But for the ones that do die, they just...stop existing.
lines.zh: : 但对那些死去的人来说，他们就……不再存在了。

lines.en: : Or get reborn or sent to heaven or some other afterlife. Different people will tell you different things.
lines.zh: : 或者转世，或者上天堂，或者去别的什么来世。不同的人会给你不同的说法。

lines.en: : What will you tell me? I trust you more than anyone else I know.
lines.zh: : 那你会怎么跟我说？我认识的人里，我最信任你。

lines.en: : I would tell you not to worry too much about it.
lines.zh: : 我会告诉你，别太为这件事担心。

lines.en: : Because you don’t want me to be sad?
lines.zh: : 因为你不希望我难过？

lines.en: : Right.
: But I’m already sad.
lines.zh: : 可我已经在难过了。

lines.en: : Do you like poetry, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢诗吗，Kaori？

lines.en: : Poetry?
: Like....knock knock poems?
lines.zh: : 比如说……敲敲门诗？

lines.en: : Those are called jokes.
lines.zh: : 那些叫笑话。

lines.en: : Poems are weird combinations of words that exist to make people feel certain ways or think certain things.
lines.zh: : 诗是奇怪的词组合，它存在的目的，是让人产生某种感受，或者想到某些东西。

lines.en: : Like laughter?
lines.zh: : 比如笑？

lines.en: : Sometimes, yes.
lines.zh: : 有时候是，没错。

lines.en: : How is that different from a joke?
lines.zh: : 那和笑话有什么不一样？

lines.en: : I...don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道。

lines.en: : I’m not really good when it comes to cheering people up, but there’s part of a poem that just popped into my head that...might explain death a little better than I can.
lines.zh: : 我其实不太擅长安慰人，不过我脑子里突然冒出了一首诗的片段，也许……能比我更好地解释死亡。

lines.en: : The only thing is that you’re going to have to imagine I’m the one who died or it will be a little awkward and not make as much sense.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是，你得想象死掉的那个人是我，否则会有点别扭，也不太说得通。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate15
: This poem makes me feel very bad!
lines.zh: : 这首诗让我感觉很糟糕！

lines.en: : The poem hasn’t even started...
lines.zh: : 诗都还没开始呢……

lines.en: : If imagining me dead doesn’t help, just...imagine me as one of the chickens or something.
lines.zh: : 如果想象我死了帮不上忙，那就……把我当成那些鸡里的一只之类的。

lines.en: : Ahh! Zombie chicken!
lines.zh: : 啊！僵尸鸡！

lines.en: : Anyway, the poem goes like this.
lines.zh: : 总之，诗是这样的。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate16
: Death is nothing at all. It does not count.
lines.zh: : 死亡什么都不是。它不算什么。

lines.en: : I have only slipped away into the next room. Nothing has happened.
lines.zh: : 我只是退进了隔壁的房间。什么都没有发生。

lines.en: : Everything remains exactly as it was. I am I, and you are you-
lines.zh: : 一切都和从前一模一样。我是我，你是你——

lines.en: : And the old life that we lived so fondly together is untouched, unchanged. Whatever we were to each other, that we are still.
lines.zh: : 我们曾如此深情地一起度过的旧日生活，未被触碰，也未曾改变。我们彼此曾经是怎样的，现在依然是怎样。

lines.en: : ...And then there’s a bunch of other shit, but you should be able to get the point.
lines.zh: : ……后面还有一堆乱七八糟的东西，不过你应该能明白意思。

lines.en: : Basically, life’s going to be exactly the same and this is nothing but a hiccup, even if you get all depressed right now.
lines.zh: : 基本上，生活还是会照原样继续下去，这只是一次小小的打嗝，哪怕你现在难过得不行。

lines.en: : Also, you should be thankful that I don’t think of you as an actual human being, because doing that with anyone else is not something I think I’d be able to live down.
lines.zh: : 还有，你该庆幸我没把你当成真正的人类，因为要对别人做这种事，我觉得我这辈子都洗不掉这个污点。

lines.en: : I had no idea Friend was so good with words! Did you write that?
lines.zh: : 没想到朋友这么会说话！那是你写的吗？

lines.en: : No. I haven’t written anything in a very long time.
lines.zh: : 不是。我已经很久很久没写过什么东西了。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate17
: Well your poem did not make me feel better, but I am impressed by how smart you are to remember so many things!
lines.zh: : 嗯，你的诗没有让我好过一点，不过你能记住这么多东西、这么聪明，我很佩服！

lines.en: : Thanks. But this wasn’t really about trying to show you how smart I am.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。不过我可不是想向你炫耀我有多聪明。

lines.en: : No no! This is a good thing!
lines.zh: : 不不！这是好事！

lines.en: : You said you were bad at remembering, but you remembered all of those words!
lines.zh: : 你说你不擅长记东西，可你把那些词全记住了！

lines.en: : Do you know any poems about chickens?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么关于鸡的诗吗？

lines.en: : Are you sure that hearing about chickens will make you feel better when chickens are kind of the reason you’re upset in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你确定听鸡的事会让你好受些吗？毕竟鸡多少就是你难过的起因啊。

lines.en: : I am not sad because of the chickens.
lines.zh: : 我不是因为鸡才难过的。

lines.en: : I am sad because of how cruel human beings can be.
lines.zh: : 我难过，是因为人类可以这么残忍。

lines.en: : But you have reminded me that not everyone is evil by confusing me with your strange knock knock joke.
lines.zh: : 不过你用你那个奇怪的敲敲门笑话把我绕晕了，也提醒了我，不是每个人都是邪恶的。

lines.en: scene black
Kaori turns around and begins to walk over to a strange table full of random objects several feet behind us.
lines.zh: Kaori 转过身，走向我们身后几英尺外那张摆满乱七八糟物件的奇怪桌子。

lines.en: I’m sure it’s something just used by the employees of one of these restaurants for their breaks or something along those lines, but I can’t help but feel like it’s eerily out of place.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，那只是附近某家餐厅的员工休息时用的东西之类的，可我还是忍不住觉得，它出现在这里有一种诡异的不协调感。

lines.en: She lifts up a stuffed rabbit and hugs it tightly before sitting down and starting to play with its ears.
lines.zh: 她拿起一只毛绒兔子紧紧抱住，然后坐下来，开始摆弄它的耳朵。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate18
: When Mini-Kaori got hurt a long time ago, she learned that the people she used to live with got hurt a lot worse.
lines.zh: : 很久以前，迷你 Kaori 受伤的时候，她才知道，曾经和她一起生活的人伤得比她重得多。

lines.en: : So bad that they disappeared forever. Like one of my light bulbs.
lines.zh: : 重到他们永远消失了。就像我的某个灯泡一样。

lines.en: : But Mini-Kaori didn’t remember those people when she woke up, so she didn’t feel any pain other than what was in her body.
lines.zh: : 可是迷你 Kaori 醒来的时候，已经不记得那些人了，所以除了身体上的痛，她什么痛都没感觉到。

lines.en: : If losing friends I never became friends with is as painful as this, what should Mini-Kaori have felt when people she actually loved died?
lines.zh: : 如果失去这些我根本没来得及交上朋友的朋友就这么痛，那迷你 Kaori 在真正爱着的人死去时，该是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Worse. Which is why I’m confused about your smile right now.
lines.zh: : 更痛。所以我现在才搞不懂你为什么在笑。

lines.en: : If I don’t smile, my eye-water will come rushing out and Friend will need to squeeze me to make me feel better.
lines.zh: : 如果我不笑，我的眼水就会涌出来，朋友就得抱紧我，才能让我好受一点。

lines.en: : I’m fine with squeezing you if you want to cry, you know.
lines.zh: : 你要是想哭，我抱紧你也没问题，你知道的。

lines.en: : Just don’t expect another poem or any advice or something like that.
lines.zh: : 只是别指望再来一首诗，或者什么建议之类的。

lines.en: : If you squeeze me, you must squeeze this rabbit as well! He is a replacement friend to help me cope with the death of John number two through however many I could fit in my arm feet!
lines.zh: : 如果你要抱我，那你也必须抱抱这只兔子！他是个替代朋友，帮我承受二号 John 到我能塞进胳膊脚里的那么多号 John 死去的痛苦！

lines.en: : You know, I feel like this is a good opportunity to teach you about stealing being wrong, but whoever left all this stuff out here is basically asking for it to be stolen.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我本来觉得这是个教你「偷东西不对」的好机会，可把这些东西丢在这儿的人，基本上就是在求着别人偷走。

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate19
: I am very sorry our fun day together had to begin with such despair.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉，我们开心的一天是以这样的绝望开场的。

lines.en: : Do you feel your shadow growing larger, Friend?
lines.zh: : 你感觉你的影子在变大吗，朋友？

lines.en: : It’s...about the same?
lines.zh: : 它……差不多老样子？

lines.en: scene kaoribigdate20
: Then we should leave this place and go somewhere even more exciting!
lines.zh: : 那我们该离开这儿，去个更让人兴奋的地方！

lines.en: : Pretty much anywhere would be more exciting than a random alleyway several blocks away from one of your workplaces.
lines.zh: : 随便哪个地方，都比离你上班的地方几个街区远的一条无名小巷更让人兴奋。

lines.en: : Then take me to the most exciting place you know!
lines.zh: : 那就带我去你知道的最让人兴奋的地方！

lines.en: : A place where normal female humans like me can have a good time with their normal male friends after suffering great loss!
lines.zh: : 一个像我这样正常的女性人类，在遭受巨大的失去之后，能和正常的男性朋友好好玩一场的地方！

lines.en: : A place with things I can consume because I have the hunger!
lines.zh: : 一个有好吃的的地方，因为我饿了！

lines.en: scene black
The most exciting place I know, huh?
lines.zh: 我知道的最让人兴奋的地方，是吧？

lines.en: That can only mean one thing.
lines.zh: 那只可能意味着一件事。

lines.en: $ kaoridate15 = True
$ kaori_love += 1
{i}Kaori’s affection has increased to [kaori_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kaori 的好感度提升到了 [kaori_love]!{/i}
